title: Raw Material Inspection
description: Premium grade resins and additives are rigorously tested in our NABL-accredited labs for molecular integrity and purity before entering the production cycle.

title: State-of-the-Art Extrusion
description: High-speed, multi-stage twin-screw extruders form the pipe core with exact dimensional accuracy, maintaining uniform wall thickness throughout the length.

title: Automated Cutting & Threading
description: Laser-guided cutting and CNC threading stations provide burr-free edges and perfect thread pitch for leak-proof joint integrity.

title: Final Quality Assurance
description: Every batch undergoes hydrostatic pressure testing, impact resistance evaluation, and dimensional checks before being cleared for dispatch.
